footprints.description: EVT LiPo connector: JST-PH 2.0mm 2-pin; pin 1 VBAT/BAT+, pin 2 GND/BAT-. Check polarity before connecting battery.
128x64 I2C OLED module, SH1106 firmware driver
ESP32-C3 Super Mini module; pinout and 22.52 mm x 18.00 mm size verified for EVT; I2C_SCL moved to GPIO10 to avoid GPIO9 boot-strapping risk; verify pitch, antenna keepout, and EN/RST.
Optional input pads feeding TP4056 IN+/IN-
TP4056 charger module; verify OUT+/OUT- protection/load-output behavior
Bourns PEC11R-4215F-S0024 12mm encoder, 24 detents, 24 PPR, 15mm flatted shaft, push switch
AP2112 input capacitor close to VIN/GND
Bulk capacitance near ESP32-C3 power input
Test point for BAT_ADC
Encoder/push-button pull-up to 3V3
ESP32-C3 local decoupling
ADC low-pass capacitor at BAT_ADC
AP2112 output capacitor close to VOUT/GND
Battery divider top resistor from VBAT to BAT_ADC
Test point for I2C_SDA
Test point for VBAT
Battery divider bottom resistor from BAT_ADC to GND
Encoder/push-button pull-up to 3V3
Test point for GND
SH1106 OLED local decoupling
Test point for SYS_RAW
Encoder/push-button pull-up to 3V3
3.3 V fixed LDO, SOT-23-5
Compact EVT v2 bottom-edge debug row: pin 1 GND, pin 2 3V3, pin 3 UART_TX/GPIO21, pin 4 UART_RX/GPIO20, pin 5 I2C_SCL/GPIO10, pin 6 GND. SYS_RAW/VBAT/SDA/BAT_ADC use adjacent round pads.
